extraction.Name: Lizzie Twiss
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, on account of not wanting to pay taxes, but that the Indian Agency told her that she would have to accept it, and she did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: she has never mortgaged or sold her land, or any part of it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: there are some taxes against it now, but no other debts
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband, whose grown sons works her allotment; and that the husband receives lease money from his allotment, these two sources being the supply of their income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in very poor health, being bothered with rheumatism; has applied to have her allotment put back in trust; has never received any aid from the County or Government; document sworn November 15, 1928
